purpose: Runs the installed wake-up router against fake session inboxes in a test world: each delivery failure recorded with its reason and retry state and delivered nowhere else, the retry rule over seeded past attempts, and a line written but never acknowledged recorded unknown and never retried.
title: Wake-up delivery failures

testCases.description: A missing socket: delivered nowhere else, recorded with its reason and retry state.
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/wake-ups.test.js::a missing socket is a failed delivery: delivered nowhere else, recorded with its reason and its retry state

testCases.description: A refused connection: delivered nowhere else, recorded with its reason and retry state.
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/wake-ups.test.js::a refused connection is a failed delivery: delivered nowhere else, recorded with its reason and its retry state

testCases.description: A rejected token: delivered nowhere else, recorded with its reason and retry state.
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/wake-ups.test.js::a rejected token is a failed delivery: delivered nowhere else, recorded with its reason and its retry state

testCases.description: A timeout before the line is written: delivered nowhere else, recorded with its reason and retry state.
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/wake-ups.test.js::a timeout before the line is written is a failed delivery: delivered nowhere else, recorded with its reason and its retry state

testCases.description: A line written but not acknowledged within the deadline is recorded unknown and never retried.
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/wake-ups.test.js::a line written but not acknowledged within the deadline is recorded unknown and never retried

testCases.description: Typical: a wake-up that failed once is retried, re-checked and delivered.
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/wake-ups.test.js::typical: a wake-up that failed once is retried by the scheduler run with the session back, re-checked and delivered

testCases.description: Heavy: the third retry inside ten minutes is delivered; never a fourth retry, and none after ten minutes.
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/wake-ups.test.js::heavy: across a session restart the third retry inside ten minutes is delivered, and there is never a fourth retry or one after ten minutes

testCases.description: A retry re-runs the identity check: a changed session or two records means not delivered, and the log says why.
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/wake-ups.test.js::a retry re-runs the identity check: with the record now naming a different session, or two records, the retry is not delivered and the log says why
